description: This source file defines two attribute classes, CollectionAgeLimitAttribute and KeepAliveAttribute, used for configuring grain collection and deactivation policies in the Orleans framework. It includes properties and methods for specifying inactivity periods and whether a grain remains active indefinitely.

classes.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute
classes.description: Attribute that specifies the inactivity period before a grain can be collected and deactivated, with configurable timespan properties and override for always active grains.

classes.name: KeepAliveAttribute
classes.description: Attribute to mark grains that should never be collected by the idle activation collector, effectively keeping them alive indefinitely.

methods.name: CollectionAgeLimitAttribute
methods.description: Constructors for setting the inactivity period, either default or via a string parsed into a TimeSpan.

methods.name: AgeLimit
methods.description: Property that computes and returns the idle activation collection age as a TimeSpan.

methods.name: Populate
methods.description: Method to populate grain properties with collection age limit information during grain initialization.

methods.name: CalculateValue
methods.description: Internal method to compute the collection age limit based on Days, Hours, Minutes, or default values.

methods.name: KeepAliveAttribute
methods.description: Populates the properties to prevent a grain from being collected, setting its idle deactivation period to indefinite.
